purpose: Teach: 責める/信憑/引き合い/駆け引き/特筆/計る/かねる/直近

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、社員、絶対、責めることなく、絶対、育ててきたぞ、お前にも、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In those founding years, I raised the staff without blame — with real conviction, son. I'm asking you to do the same.
lines.style: Quiet weight. Measured pace, each phrase deliberately placed. The voice of someone who has earned the right to be brief. Slight pause before 'son' — acknowledgment and responsibility both.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの言葉、本気で、絶対、信憑性、絶対、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、信じております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Your words carry real weight — and I hold your faith in the staff close. I'm grateful, and I mean it.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Steady eye contact in the voice. A beat after 'yes' — absorbing the weight. Warm underneath the formality. Not repeating for emphasis, but for genuine affirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、競合を、絶対、引き合いに、絶対、出してきたぞ、お父さん、お前にも、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the early days, I never played competitors against each other — not once. Your father did it right. I'm asking the same of you.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The voice settles on 'competitors' like setting something down carefully. Slow, deliberate. A quiet urgency underneath — this matters and he knows it matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、駆け引き、絶対、なく、絶対、誠実、絶対、貫いてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Since your time, I've kept that standard — honesty without games, always. I'm grateful for that inheritance.
lines.style: Calm commitment. A light nod in the voice on 'always.' The phrasing shows he understands the principle, not just the rule. Steady breathing. Not defensive — just clear about what he's chosen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期の業績、本気で、絶対、特筆すべき、絶対、ものだったぞ、お父さん、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The numbers in those years — they were genuinely remarkable. Your father built something real. I'm asking you to remember that.
lines.style: A note of something remembered — pride mixed with looking back. Slightly softer than before. The voice carries a little weight of time. 'Real' lands with quiet significance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、業績、絶対、計ることを、続けてきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Since your era, we've kept measuring what matters. We haven't stopped. I'm grateful for that standard.
lines.style: Clear and steady. No flourish — just honest continuation. A slight warmth surfaces on 'grateful' — not relief, but genuine recognition of what was passed down. Composed, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お断りしかねる、絶対、要請、絶対、お父さん、絶対、慎重に、対応したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, there were requests I had to turn down — difficult ones. Your father handled them carefully, with real judgment. Do the same.
lines.style: Measured and direct. The voice carries quiet authority without raising. A slight pause on 'carefully' — showing what it cost to say no well. Not coldness — the weight of hard choices respected.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。直近、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お元気で、絶対、嬉しいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm glad to see you well — and carrying this forward means everything. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Warm underneath. A genuine note enters here — not formal, but sincere. Slight softening at 'truly grateful.' The closing carries both respect and affection. Breath settles. This is the moment of real understanding between them.
